user.title: China Light & Power (CLP) Setup Guide
user.description:
### 📋 How to Obtain CLP Token Credentials:

1. **Log in**: Open Chrome or Edge (Incognito window recommended) and log in to [CLP Online](https://www.clp.com.hk).
2. **Open Console**: Press **F12** (or right-click and select Inspect), then switch to the **Console** tab.
3. **Quick Copy**: Paste and run the following command in the console:
```javascript
console.log("Access Token:\n" + localStorage.getItem("act") + "\n\nRefresh Token:\n" + localStorage.getItem("rct"));
```
Copy the entire output printed in the console.
4. **Important Notice**:
- Close the browser window directly when done. **DO NOT click "Sign Out"** (signing out will invalidate your tokens).
- Click **"Next"** below and paste the copied text directly into the one-click input box.

tokens.title: Token Authentication
tokens.description: You can paste the entire copied block containing Access Token and Refresh Token into the multiline box below. The separate fields below can be left empty.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate CLP Account
reauth_confirm.description:
Your CLP login credentials have expired. Follow these steps to obtain a new token:

1. Log in to CLP and open Console (F12).
2. Run `console.log("Access Token:\n" + localStorage.getItem("act") + "\n\nRefresh Token:\n" + localStorage.getItem("rct"));` and copy the output.
3. Close the browser window (do not sign out), then paste into the box below.
